# File: backup.sh
# Purpose: Back up files from source to destination directory
# Project: coding-screen | Date: 2026-07-11

# Robust backup script with proper error handling
# This script handles spaces, missing directories, and other edge cases

set -euo pipefail

# Default values
DIR=${1:-.}
DEST=${2:-.}

# Validate source directory exists
if [ ! -d "$DIR" ]; then
    echo "Error: Source directory '$DIR' does not exist" >&2
    exit 1
fi

# Validate destination directory exists or create it
if [ ! -d "$DEST" ]; then
    echo "Warning: Destination directory '$DEST' does not exist. Creating it..."
    if ! mkdir -p "$DEST"; then
        echo "Error: Failed to create destination directory '$DEST'" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
fi

# Use find to handle filenames with spaces properly
# Process each file in the source directory
find "$DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type f -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
    # Extract filename from path
    filename=$(basename "$file")
    dest_file="${DEST}/${filename}"
    
    # Copy file to destination
    if ! cp "$file" "$dest_file"; then
        echo "Error: Failed to copy '$file' to '$dest_file'" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    
    echo "Copied '$file' to '$dest_file'"
    
    # Check if file was copied successfully
    if [ ! -f "$dest_file" ]; then
        echo "Error: File was not copied successfully" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

# Process directories in the source directory
find "$DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type d -not -path "$DIR" | while IFS= read -r dir; do
    dir_name=$(basename "$dir")
    dest_dir="${DEST}/${dir_name}"
    
    # Create directory in destination
    if ! mkdir -p "$dest_dir"; then
        echo "Error: Failed to create directory '$dest_dir'" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    
    echo "Created directory '$dest_dir'"
    
    # Check if directory was created successfully
    if [ ! -d "$dest_dir" ]; then
        echo "Error: Directory was not created successfully" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

echo "Backup complete"
"}
